rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong term for an airport passenger terminal.

example.english: We’ll wait for you outside the airport passenger terminal.
example.traditional: 我哋喺客運大樓門口等你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 haak3 wan6 daai6 lau4 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for a computer or communications device used to enter or display data.

example.english: This terminal is broken, so I can’t enter data.
example.traditional: 呢部終端機壞咗，入唔到資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 zung1 dyun1 gei1 waai6 zo2 jap6 m4 dou2 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use this for a harbour or ferry terminal rather than an airport or rail terminal.

example.english: We have to queue at the ferry terminal to buy tickets for Cheung Chau.
example.traditional: 去長洲要喺碼頭排隊買飛。
example.jyutping: heoi3 coeng4 zau1 jiu3 hai2 maa5 tau4 paai4 deoi6 maai5 fei1

rows.note: Use this for the end station of a rail route, and similarly for a bus route.

example.english: This bus only turns around after reaching the terminal.
example.traditional: 呢架巴士去到總站先會返轉頭。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 baa1 si2 heoi3 dou3 zung2 zaam6 sin1 wui5 faan1 zyun2 tau4
